title: Wandering Automaton

reward.description: A tiny ticking engine of springs and crystal. It beats a little faster when you're near.

hints: Keep x and y variables starting at 0, and update one of them for each letter.
For steps_until_home, check (x, y) == (0, 0) after each move. Use enumerate(commands) to know which step you're on.
For walk_grid, first find the 'A' with two nested loops. For each move, work out the new row/col, and only move if that spot is inside the grid and isn't '#'.
